name: Combat Awareness
body:
School divination; Level sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a cat’s-eye marble)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level (D)

DESCRIPTION

Combat awareness sharpens your battle senses, granting you a +2 insight bonus to your AC and Reflex saves.
